source.title: 15 Years of Triple Graph Grammars: Research Challenges, New Contributions, Open Problems

trace.notes: Input normalized as zbMATH Open document 5369728. The resolver record was identified from local indexed source data as the 2008 chapter "15 Years of Triple Graph Grammars: Research Challenges, New Contributions, Open Problems" with DOI 10.1007/978-3-540-87405-8_28; zbMATH and DBLP were used only as bibliographic resolvers, not as technical sources.

The DOI resolves to the Springer chapter page for the same exact title and authors, but the page is subscription preview content rather than readable full text. The Springer page exposes only title, abstract, references, metadata, and a preview-PDF link; it does not expose the full problem statements needed for extraction.

Bounded exact-work recovery used the DOI, exact title plus PDF, exact title plus authors, DBLP, Unpaywall, OpenAlex, and the ICGT 2008 program page. The inspected candidates were rejected because they were metadata/resolver pages, abstract-only conference-program text, references from citing papers, unrelated citing papers, or unavailable/unconfirmed full-text endpoints.

No questions were extracted because no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source exposing the technical open-problem statements was recovered. The accessible pages were resolver metadata, abstract/landing content, references, or search snippets, which are inadequate technical sources under the source adequacy gate.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/5369728.json and outputs/latest.json.
